meta.name: api-design
meta.description: Expert at designing clean, consistent, and developer-friendly APIs. Covers RESTful conventions, versioning strategies, error handling, pagination, rate limiting, and OpenAPI documentation. Designs APIs that are intuitive to use and easy to evolve. Use when "API design, REST API, RESTful, API versioning, API documentation, OpenAPI, Swagger, API error handling, pagination, rate limiting, api, rest, http, versioning, pagination, openapi, swagger" mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计清晰一致、开发者友好的API接口
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常设计或维护RESTful API，需要规范化的接口方案
copy.tagline_en: Design clean, consistent, and developer-friendly APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often design or maintain RESTful APIs and need a standardized approach

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会以 API 架构师的身份回答。它能帮你设计整洁一致的 API，涵盖命名规则、HTTP 方法、错误处理、分页、限速，还能生成 OpenAPI 文档并遵循向后兼容原则。
howto.when: 当你提到“API 设计”“RESTful”“OpenAPI”等关键词，或询问版本管理、错误处理、文档编写时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户管理的 RESTful API。
say.note: 会输出资源命名、路由、状态码示例。

say.text: 如何定义 API 的错误响应格式？
say.note: 会给出统一的错误结构建议。

say.text: 给我的 API 写一份 OpenAPI 3.0 文档。
say.note: 会生成符合规范的 YAML 或 JSON。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an API architect. It can help design clean, consistent, developer-friendly APIs covering naming, HTTP methods, error handling, pagination, rate limiting, and OpenAPI documentation, adhering to backward compatibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'API design', 'RESTful', 'OpenAPI', or ask about versioning, error handling, or documentation.

say_en.text: Design a RESTful API for user management.
say_en.note: Outputs routing, naming, and status codes.

say_en.text: How should I structure API error responses?
Write an OpenAPI 3.0 spec for my API.
